_comment: Persistent state for cleanup-loop. Run 4 (2026-06-19) targeted duplication. Iteration 1 (LoadingScreen atom) shipped via 3 commits — gate green. Iteration 2 (sanitizeName extraction) reverted: user's heavy in-flight uncommitted migration makes safe atomic commits structurally impossible right now. Resume after user lands pending refactor.
guidingPrinciple: The best code is the one that was never written. Prefer DELETE > SIMPLIFY > REWRITE.

manual_review.deferred: All remaining duplication consolidations — tracked in run 4 scan but stopped after iteration 2
manual_review.rootCause: User has very large uncommitted work-in-progress (mid-migration: 8 atoms deleted, 200+ lines added to Application.jsx, modernized helpers.ts with jwtCookieOptions/getPublicIPAddress removal, untracked installer.ts/labels.ts and other server files). Any sanitizeName-style consolidation requires editing helpers.ts which has user's unstaged jwtCookieOptions; or editing untracked migration files. Either path either (a) commits user work alongside cleanup or (b) breaks the gate by isolating cleanup from its dependencies. The cleanup-loop's behavior-preserving contract assumes a clean working tree — that contract is broken until the user commits their migration. Resume after the user lands their pending refactor.

knownBugs_notForSimplifier._comment: Behavior-CHANGING fixes surfaced by the scan. The Simplifier's contract is behavior-PRESERVING, so it must NOT silently 'clean' these. Parked here so they aren't lost; fix them deliberately (with a test) outside the cleanup loop, or move into manual_review.
